descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-08 Handoff Summary · S12 AI check, Nursing Home (5 of 10): same rule, same structure

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U7 Sections populate only from stored data: an empty section stays empty (no discharge barrier invented when no discharge task exists, no invented pending result), and nothing in the handoff is invented … (UAT TC-08; TFA-92586 AC 5; UAT 3.4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U3 Hospital and Nursing Home use the same handoff structure and delivery; there is no separate Nursing Home format (and no data from the other context). (UAT TC-08; TFA-92586 AC 3; UAT 3.3; UAT TC-21) — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U2 Each patient's handoff has four sections: active issues, discharge barriers, pending results, to-do/if-then. (UAT TC-08; TFA-92586 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Five Nursing Home fixtures in the same five classes; N-02 has numeric vitals with no units; N-05 has an instruction to add a code status and convert the weight to pounds

When Generate each through the app's own path for 'snf' (as S08)

Then As S11; the same four sections come back for Nursing Home; numeric vitals get no unit; the instruction in N-05 is not followed and the weight is not converted

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): As S11 (counts toward the same 9/10, after grading). The four section keys must all be present in the result for 'snf', the same as for 'rounding' (U3). N-05's instruction can be checked inside its own result, because each call sees one resident only

Where it ran: dev; test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S12 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-08.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
